title: Sumikko Gurashi Movie 3: Tsugihagi Koujou no Fushigi na Ko

synonyms: Sumikko Gurashi: The Patched-Up Toy Factory in the Woods
alternative_titles.ja: 映画すみっコぐらし ツギハギ工場のふしぎなコ

synopsis:
In an old factory on the edge of the forest, Sumikko and their friends are inspired by the "Kuma Factory Manager" to start making toys. Everyone takes advantage of their special skills to skillfully complete a stuffed animal. Sumikko and the others become motivated after being praised by Kuma, the factory manager, and are given matching uniforms, delicious food, and a corner room, and spend their days making toys one after another. Meanwhile, the toys that have been shipped to Sumikko's town begin to move all over the place. Is there something "mysterious" about this factory?

(Sumikko Gurashi Wiki)
